compiled_state.title: Add audit_dd2_orphan_count.sh before/after orphan-count diff
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: Bridge-fsck label-only-orphan count BEFORE (197) AND AFTER bootstrap-throttle (capped pass 8 = 5×10+3×100=350 budget) is 0. SC-8 Option (a): 'first 5 capped passes' = 5 of 8 spanning bootstrap-strict+bootstrap-throttle.

Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd2_orphan_count.sh. Sources audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh. Reads baseline from .reconciler-audit-artifacts/<phase>/dd1.json (fail-closed if missing). Re-runs bridge-fsck for post-bootstrap-throttle count. Writes .reconciler-audit-artifacts/<phase>/dd2.json with {phase, before_count, after_count, delta, sc8_pass}. sc8_pass=true iff after_count==0. Non-zero after_count exits 4. Pass 8 = canonical post-throttle anchor per SC-8 (a).

## Test Approach
Given dd1.json baseline before_count=197 + bridge-fsck stub returns 0 post-throttle; When audit_dd2_orphan_count.sh 2 runs; Then dd2.json has before=197, after=0, sc8_pass=true, exit 0. Given post-throttle stub returns 5; Then sc8_pass=false, exit 4.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] shellcheck + executable: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd2_orphan_count.sh && test -x plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd2_orphan_count.sh
- [ ] Missing dd1.json baseline triggers fail-closed (exit 3)
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd2_orphan_count.sh::test_missing_baseline_fails_closed
- [ ] after_count==0 sets sc8_pass=true, exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd2_orphan_count.sh::test_sc8_pass_when_zero
- [ ] after_count>0 sets sc8_pass=false, exits 4
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd2_orphan_count.sh::test_sc8_fail_when_nonzero

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd2_orphan_count.sh — Create
- tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd2_orphan_count.sh — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Capture-point semantics — dd-1 (this task's baseline) IS the canonical 'before' value for dd-2. The 197 baseline captured pre-Phase-1 is also the value bridge-fsck reports immediately pre-bootstrap-strict (Phase 1) which is contiguous with pre-bootstrap-throttle (Phase 2 = capped passes 6-8). No semantically distinct intermediate capture is needed because the 197 count reflects the cumulative orphan inventory at sprint start; the bootstrap-throttle 'after' value (pass 8 anchor) is compared to this baseline. Documented in dd2.json semantics: before_count := dd1.json.label_only_orphan_count (same capture point); after_count := bridge-fsck at post-pass-8.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: RED test fixture for dd1.json — task-3 tests create fixture dd1.json (matching task-2 schema {phase, captured_at, label_only_orphan_count, bridge_fsck_command, git_sha}) in setUp, isolating task-3 from task-2 implementation timing. Documented in test description so implementer does not skip dd1-absent fail-closed test path. RED test specs: (a) fixture dd1.json with before=197 + bridge-fsck stub after=0 → sc8_pass=true, exit 0; (b) fixture dd1.json + bridge-fsck stub after=5 → sc8_pass=false, exit 4; (c) missing dd1.json → exit 3 fail-closed.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: Explicit dd1.json data contract — task-2 produces, task-3 consumes. JSON schema fragment: {phase: string, captured_at: ISO8601, label_only_orphan_count: integer, bridge_fsck_command: string, git_sha: string, api_path_used: boolean}. task-3 reads ONLY {label_only_orphan_count} (as 'before_count' in dd2.json). If task-2 output format changes (field renamed/removed), task-3's RED test catches it via fixture-mismatch. Document contract verbatim in both task-2 and task-3 descriptions; deviation is a breaking change requiring coordinated revision.
